title: Alive & Free
about: A track about freedom, presence, and fully stepping into who I am.
description: Alive & Free acts as the release point of the album, focusing on living in the moment without restriction. It reflects clarity, confidence, and ownership of identity after everything that came before it. The track closes the progression by showing what it feels like to move freely without needing approval or direction from anything external.
